summary: The overall sentiment among players is predominantly positive regarding the core football experience and fun factor with friends, though a notable minority expresses deep frustration. Major criticisms focus on poor optimization, intrusive anti-cheat errors, copy-paste annual releases, microtransactions, and recurring bugs in career modes. Conversely, positive and neutral reviewers enjoy the gameplay mechanics, nostalgia, and casual matches.
